subject: Removing an element from a vector by name

messages.author: b8c77fa5305c80cb
messages.subject: Removing an element from a vector by name
parts:
Hi,
I have a vector with names for example:
v = 1:10;
names(v) = letters[1:10]

now I want to move the value of "c" to be the first.
So I wanted to do the following:

a = v["c"]
b = v[-"c"]
v = c(a,b);

The problem is that the second line (b = b[-"c"]) gives me an error: Error in -"c" : invalid argument to unary operator
I know I could do this if i would have used the index (number) but I do not have the number, just the name.
I would appreciate any help...
